findings.detail: Block 15: «доверяет мне мелкие подробности» is a misleading literal phrase. Revise as the minister being trusted to handle minor practical details.

source_anchor.quote: Elvina typically trusts me to handle all the small details.

translation_anchor.quote: Обычно Эльвина доверяет мне мелкие подробности.

findings.detail: Block 18: «неизмеримые ответы» is an unnatural calque of unquantifiable answers; express the absence of measurable criteria in literary Russian.

source_anchor.quote: That was exactly the sort of unquantifiable answer that tormented her.

translation_anchor.quote: Именно такие неизмеримые ответы приводили Клэрион в отчаяние.

findings.detail: Block 60: «звучал как всегда исполненно долга» is ungrammatical. Convey Artemis's habitual sense of duty in a natural Russian construction.

source_anchor.quote: Artemis sounded as duty bound as ever

translation_anchor.quote: Голос Артемис звучал как всегда исполненно долга

findings.detail: Block 72: «пришло в себя» implies regaining consciousness or recovering; reoriented itself means the monster adjusted its direction/position before she landed.
Block 74: «сквозь кроличий визг ужаса» is stiff literal phrasing. Preserve the peculiar rabbit-scream image while using natural Russian syntax.

source_anchor.quote: through the rabbit scream of terror her thoughts had become

translation_anchor.quote: сквозь кроличий визг ужаса, в который превратились её мысли

findings.detail: Block 93: «недостойной королевы» implies she is unworthy of the title, whereas unqueenly describes feeling unlike a queen. Preserve emphasis and the self-perceived contrast.
